note: Editorial provenance only; not rendered. Unless an author-supplied revision is identified in the example’s source, examples paraphrase events from the supplied EPUB. Their assignment to ACE concepts is an explanatory reading, not a quotation. Preserve the distinction between the museum dream and waking events, and do not reveal the causes of the sound-system mystery. The author’s revised Agency example explicitly includes the outcome of the job decision.

agency.example.source: Author-supplied What is ACE? second revision, 2026-10-25
agency.example.scene: Guided by the Integration phase of Agency, Hedayat turned down the tempting job offer on the Kabulis’ space project. He chose to continue work that paid less but gave him a greater sense of meaning.

connection.example.scene: Hedayat wanted Ava to believe in his imaginary world and his digital children; Ava wanted to protect Hedayat from losing the boundary between reality and imagination. Both were thinking about their own wishes, rather than the needs of their relationship.

exchange.example.scene: Instead of taking money in return for supplying solar panels, SAS Energy asks its customers to commit to returning the value of what they have received in the future, according to their abilities and resources.

preparation.example.title: The Ring of the Nibelung
preparation.example.scene: The audio system has disturbed Hedayat and his neighbors for two nights. He browses its settings, thinking about Bluetooth.

decision.example.title: The Ring of the Nibelung
decision.example.scene: Hedayat tries a firmware update and believes it will solve the nighttime disturbance. The card separates the intended remedy from carrying it out.

action.example.title: The Ring of the Nibelung
action.example.scene: He uses the remote to start the update; the audio system restarts when the update completes.

feedback.example.title: The Ring of the Nibelung
feedback.example.scene: At 3:03 a.m. loud music returns, contradicting his belief that the problem was solved. Unable to silence it with the remote, he pulls the power plug.

exploration.example.title: Unveiling the Mysteries
exploration.example.scene: In the museum dream Hedayat enters the mysterious theater despite Ava's reluctance. Chapter 18 explicitly revisits this adventure as Exploration.

stabilization.example.title: Stabilization
stabilization.example.scene: Solar batteries sustain Hedayat's apartment during power outages; he disconnects them when city power returns because they drain too fast. Chapter 15 also shows him switching the battery into the circuit on arriving home during a blackout.

expansion.example.title: Exploration and Expansion
expansion.example.scene: After the explanation of creativity in Expansion, Hedayat improvises on the setar while Yulia improvises her dance.

integration.example.title: Integration
integration.example.scene: While considering the better-paid Kabulis job, Hedayat examines loyalty to Simon and the team, their work for a free Internet, and what that goal means to him. The example withholds his eventual decision.
